findings.title: File is missing from a ConfigMap or Secret volume
findings.cause: container web exits because /etc/app/config.yaml does not exist: ConfigMap app, mounted at /etc/app, has no key config.yaml (it has config.yml); its log says: "cat: can't open '/etc/app/config.yaml': No such file or directory"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
evidence.detail: cat: can't open '/etc/app/config.yaml': No such file or directory

evidence.what: container web mounts volume config (ConfigMap app) at /etc/app

findings.fix: Add key config.yaml to ConfigMap app, or point the app at a file the volume has.
